opportunity-change.eventDescription: One verified new notice, amendment/version change, or response-deadline change written to the dataset. Baseline, no-change, uncertain, incomplete, and outage rows are not charged.

pricingNote: Proposed price only. Set up this custom event in Apify Console, disable automatic apify-default-dataset-item and apify-actor-start events, and confirm platform-usage handling and a run charge cap before publication. Account and payout actions are owner-only.
